assertions.title: Dashboard shows total spent for selected month

steps.action: Create category ut-bud-agg-20260323-cat and seed March 2031 transactions: txn-1=$40 (2031-03-05), txn-2=$30 (2031-03-10)
steps.expected: Dashboard totalSpent equals sum of month transactions
steps.observed: Dashboard for March 2031 showed Total Spent $70.00; independent sum is 40+30=70

steps.action: Create txn-3=$20 (2031-03-15), then edit txn-3 amount to $50, then delete txn-3
steps.observed: After create totalSpent=$90.00 (40+30+20), after edit totalSpent=$120.00 (40+30+50), after delete totalSpent returned to $70.00

evidence.network: network-dashboard-baseline.json: GET /api/dashboard?year=2031&month=3 -> 200 totalSpent 70.00; network-dashboard-after-create.json -> 200 totalSpent 90.00; network-dashboard-after-edit.json -> 200 totalSpent 120.00; network-dashboard-after-delete.json -> 200 totalSpent 70.00

steps.action: Set budget to $100 for March 2031 with totalSpent $70
Edit txn-3 to raise March 2031 totalSpent to $120
steps.observed: Dashboard Remaining displayed -$20.00 and Over budget indicator, matching 100-120=-20

evidence.network: network-dashboard-baseline.json and network-dashboard-after-edit.json include GET /api/dashboard responses with remaining 30.00 and -20.00

steps.observed: Dashboard showed 70.0% with progress bar labeled 'Budget usage: 70.0%'

steps.action: After editing txn-3 so March 2031 totalSpent is $120
steps.observed: Dashboard showed 120.0% with progress bar labeled 'Budget usage: 120.0%'

steps.action: Baseline on dashboard for March 2031 after budget set
Edit transaction ut-bud-agg-20260323-txn-3 amount from $20 to $50
steps.observed: After edit: Spent=$120.00, Remaining=-$20.00, Usage=120.0%, Over budget shown

evidence.network: network-transaction-create.json: POST /api/transactions -> 201; network-transaction-edit.json: PUT /api/transactions/778 -> 200; network-transaction-delete.json: DELETE /api/transactions/778 -> 204; network-dashboard-after-create.json / after-edit / after-delete show corresponding GET /api/dashboard aggregates

frictions.description: Dashboard month selector is only previous/next buttons. Reaching 2031-03 from default 2026-03 required many month steps each time dashboard was reopened.
frictions.resolution: Used repeated UI clicks in the same browser session to move month context to March 2031 before each dashboard verification.

summary: Tested 4 assertions (VAL-BUD-003, VAL-BUD-004, VAL-BUD-005, VAL-CROSS-006): all passed. Dashboard aggregates matched manual calculations for March 2031 and updated correctly after transaction create/edit/delete, including overspent (>100%) behavior.
